readout_other: Concurrent TUS-fMRI (visually evoked BOLD in LGN and V1); MR-ARFI displacement; contrast decrement detection task; forced-choice blinding test
direction_notes: LGN-TUS increased visually evoked BOLD in the stimulated LGN and ipsilateral V1 relative to temporal-lobe control sonication, with the size of the effect scaling with MR-ARFI displacement but not with simulated intensity. No group-level behavioural effect.

exposures.label: LGN-TUS (left lateral geniculate nucleus), with temporal grey matter as active control site

target.label: lateral geniculate nucleus of the thalamus (LGN)

timing.protocol_description: A 145 ms continuous pulse with 7 ms linear ramping, delivered six times per 15-second block time-locked to contrast decrements (870 ms per block); TUS in 6/7 of the epochs after an unstimulated first epoch, characterised by the authors as an average PRF of 0.46 Hz. Two 10-minute scans.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The experiment was conducted in a single session.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Stimulation was applied in an online approach at a fundamental frequency of 500 kHz
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: a free-water spatial-peak pulse-average intensity (I ) of 50 W/cm
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: Ultrasound stimulation was delivered using a 64-element phased array transducer (Imasonic SAS, Voray-sur-l’Ognon, France) driven by an IGT generator (Image Guided Therapy, Pessac, France)
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: Ultrasound stimulation was delivered using a 64-element phased array transducer (Imasonic SAS, Voray-sur-l’Ognon, France) driven by an IGT generator (Image Guided Therapy, Pessac, France)
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: a 145 ms continuous pulse with 7 ms linear ramping

flags.reason: MR-ARFI scans used a higher free-water Isppa of 75 W/cm2 with 7 ms pulses; not recorded as an exposure.
Individualised k-Plan simulations were run but simulated in situ intensity values are not stated in the main text.
Paper says counterbalanced order and pseudorandomized blocks; no explicit random allocation statement.
Single uninterrupted 145 ms burst per trial treated as continuous; the average PRF of 0.46 Hz is given only as a description.
Masking white noise and a 4 kHz tone; blinding tested at end of session; the authors note the tone masked rather than matched the sound.
Control was active TUS to left temporal grey matter plus a no-TUS baseline condition.
